aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable evidence rows but incorrectly merges several distinct investigations into one changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor mixes JIG old/new, frame cavity, VP bond amount, and frame bending conditions.
Baseline and test conditions are not comparable across sheets.
Outcome metric for the JIG comparison is mislabeled as VP bond amount.
Measurement/stat outcomes include header-derived or unrelated summaries not valid comparisons.
Subgroup keys are arbitrary and do not preserve sheet-specific grouping context.
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases or changed factors by investigation sheet/context.
Keep JIG Frame+Yoke Old vs New as its own verified comparison.
Treat VP bond MAX vs MIN, frame cavity checks, and frame bending checks separately.
Relabel outcome metrics using the actual section for each comparison.
Remove header-derived measurement summaries unless tied to a valid condition comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient until regrouped by comparable changed condition.
